verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs say users can 'run scenarios at the touch of a button to assess different assumptions', which covers creating scenarios. The evidence never shows side-by-side scenario comparison, and the variance-analysis claim is budget-gap analysis, not scenario-versus-scenario comparison. missing for 10: documented side-by-side scenario comparison views, detail on how scenarios are created and managed (e.g. hiring wave, slipped quarter, downside case), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create scenarios (a hiring wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case) and compare them side by side

citations.quote: Run scenarios at the touch of a button to assess different assumptions
